name: Cliniko
description: Appointments, online booking, treatment notes, invoices, and online payments for allied-health clinics, priced per practitioner. An osteopath and her developer partner started it in 2010, using a home-renovation loan. Australia. Privately owned.

mentions.evidence: A story page dated July 2026 says 65 employees and more than 65,000 health professionals. In February 2021 they said customers collected $15 million online in under a year after payments launched. That $15 million is money the clinics took, not Cliniko's revenue. In January 2026 they said $3 million donated to charity. The Australian Financial Review, in June 2016, said it was still bootstrapped with 20,000 paying practitioners and a 20-person team on 30-hour weeks. GetLatka estimates about $1.5 million as of September 2025, with 14 employees. That estimate sits far under the company's own staff count of 65, so it is shown as a data-site guess, not the figure.
mentions.indieAngle: A clinic owner and a developer, no investors, a whole profession. The same shape in another language.

whyItPrints: The clinic runs the day in it, and the patient notes make leaving hard. They say they turn down venture capital. They give 2 percent of revenue to charity.
